wiki.quote: Пусть этот поход будет последним, я жажду мира.

entries.name: Brewmaster
lines: Dispel Magic from Storm instantly removes Heavenly Grace and Guardian Angel from Omniknight's allies in its radius of effect.

entries.name: Doom
lines: Doom turns Omniknight into a walking creep, or completely takes out his buffed cores, also removing Heavenly Grace and Guardian Angel in the process.
With Devour used on Satyr Banisher, Doom will have access to Satyr Banisher's Purge, which will allow him to remove Heavenly Grace and Guardian Angel.

entries.name: Enchantress
lines: Enchantress's Impetus deals pure damage instead of physical damage and ignores Guardian Angel, thus fully negating one of Omniknight's most important abilities for teamfights.
Similar to Doom, Enchantress can use Enchant on Satyr Banisher, which will give her access to Satyr Banisher's Purge, and allow her to remove Heavenly Grace and Guardian Angel.

entries.name: Invoker
lines: Tornado dispels Heavenly Grace and Guardian Angel from multiple targets.
Guardian Angel is generally useless against Invoker as he primarily relies on magical damage.
E.M.P. depletes Omniknight's already small mana pool.
Invoker's many disables keep Omniknight's team occupied until Guardian Angel times out.

entries.name: Jakiro
lines: Jakiro's area-of-effect abilities that deal magical damsge make it hard for Omniknight to save multiple enemy heroes at once with Purification and Repel, and Guardian Angel and to harass Omniknight on lane.
Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Macropyre allows Jakiro to deal pure damage and slow enemy heroes which can pierce debuff immunity, rendering both Repel and Guardian Angel useless.

entries.name: Lina
lines: Guardian Angel is generally useless against Lina as she primarily relies on magical damage. Lina can also dispel it with Eul's Scepter of Divinity as she is a hero who often goes for it. Eul's Scepter of Divinity can later be upgraded into Wind Waker, which will allow Lina to escape from Omniknight.

Laguna Blade can often finish off Omniknight's allies before he can save them with Purification and Repel. This can become even worse once Lina picks Laguna Blade damage is pure and pierces spell immunity talent, which will allow it to ignore both, any form of spell immunity and Guardian Angel.

entries.name: Luna
lines: Guardian Angel does not offer protection from Eclipse, though it will negate damage from Moon Glaives.
Luna's high magical damage from Lucent Beam and Eclipse can often finish allied heroes before Omniknight can save them with Purification.

entries.name: Naga Siren
lines: Although Naga Siren relies mostly on physical damage, Song of the Siren can be used to time out Guardian Angel, giving Naga Siren's team an easy opportunity to counter-initiate.
Radiance allows it's owner to deal magical damage to multiple enemy heroes at once, and since Naga Siren often buys it, Guardian Angel is not a very good ability for protection against Naga Siren.

Likewise, Nuker build Naga Siren (which primarly consists of items such as Radiance, Ethereal Blade, Dagon and Veil of Discord) can render Guardian Angel useless. Although Nuker is not a role Naga Siren should be playing.

entries.name: Oracle
lines: Fortune's End's AoE dispel will remove Heavenly Grace and Guardian Angel.

entries.name: Outworld Destroyer
lines: Arcane Orb's pure damage penetrates Guardian Angel's defense.
Astral Imprisonment's mana steal is devastating to Omniknight's already low mana pool.

entries.name: Rubick
lines: All of Omniknight's abilities are valuable for Rubick to Spell Steal, and Omniknight has no throwaway ability to cover his last used spell.

entries.name: Silencer
lines: Global Silence takes Omniknight out of the fight completely.

Glaives of Wisdom are a great harass vs Omniknight during the laning stages of the game, since it doesn't aggro creeps & ignores his high base armor. It deals pure damage, which means it can also go through Guardian Angel.
Silencer's intelligence steal can also cause Omniknight to falter in the early phases as it reduces his ability to use his spells.

entries.name: Sven
lines: Although Sven relies often on physical damage, an Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Storm Hammer can dispel Guardian Angel with its wide radius.
Heroes with large magical AoE damage will fare well against Omniknight: Lich, Ancient Apparition, Jakiro, Disruptor.
Heroes who can harass Omniknight out of lane will keep him weak in the mid game: Viper, Venomancer, Clinkz.
Heroes who can drain mana can make Omniknight useless after he uses one or two abilities: Lion, Anti-Mage, Nyx Assassin.
Heroes that can purge buffs can dispel Guardian Angel: Invoker, Shadow Demon, Oracle.

Orchid Malevolence and other items that prevents the casting of abilities can make Omniknight useless. However, skilled Omniknight can easily counter this issue by purchasing Guardian Greaves, which allows him to dispel the silence.
Eul's Scepter of Divinity and Nullifier can dispel Guardian Angel. Eul's Scepter of Divinity can later be upgraded into Wind Waker, which will allow it's owner to espace from Omniknight.
Radiance allows it's owner to deal magical damage to multiple enemy heroes affected by Guardian Angel's protection.
Spirit Vessel and Shiva's Guard can heavily reduce any healing Omniknight tries to provide to the heroes affected by them.
Dagon combined with Ethereal Blade and Veil of Discord can often kill enemy heroes before Omniknight can save them.

Revenant's Brooch will allow heroes reliant on basic attacks to have their next five attacks deal magical damage, and thus, ignore Guardian Angel's protection, making Omniknight weak even against heroes he naturally counters.

entries.name: Axe
lines: Omniknight's healing prevents allies from dropping low enough for Culling Blade
Heavenly Grace dispels Battle Hunger.
Axe also tends to get close to allied heroes in order to damage them with his Counter Helix, which can easily be punished by Purification.

entries.name: Chaos Knight
lines: Phantasms can be easily killed with Purification.
Heavenly Grace dispels the stun from Chaos Bolt and the armor reduction from Reality Rift.
Guardian Angel works well against Chaos Knight's overwhelming reliance on physical burst damage.

entries.name: Death Prophet
lines: Exorcism's damage is blocked by Guardian Angel.
Heavenly Grace can dispel Silence allies if Omniknight is able to cast it.

entries.name: Faceless Void
lines: Guardian Angel can negate all the physical damage output from Faceless Void during Chronosphere.
If Faceless Void Time Walks on top of an ally Purification + Heavenly Grace can turn the fight around.

entries.name: Juggernaut
lines: Omnislash (and Swiftslash) is blocked by Guardian Angel.

entries.name: Legion Commander
lines: Both Guardian Angel and Purification are perfect counters against Duel.

entries.name: Phantom Assassin
lines: Purification and Hammer of Purity can easily catch Phantom Assassin once she jumps with Phantom Strike in to attack.
Heavenly Grace can be used to dispel slow from Stifling Dagger, and disables from the items Phantom Assassin relies on.

Phantom Assassin depends entirely on physical attacks and her damage output is 100% physical. Therefore, since she has no any sources of magical damage output and hates going for items that deal magical damage like Dagon, Ethereal Blade and Revenant's Brooch, Guardian Angel will render her completely useless.
Purification, Heavenly Grace and Guardian Angel can be used to save an allied hero before Phantom Assassin can finish them off with Coup de Grace.

entries.name: Winter Wyvern
lines: Guardian Angel completely counters Winter's Curse if Omniknight is able to cast it.
Heroes who rely strongly on melee physical damage will fare badly against Omniknight's Guardian Angel: Phantom Assassin, Juggernaut, Fairy Knight, Lycan, Ursa, Troll Warlord

entries.name: Clockwerk
lines: A Purification on Clockwerk while he is fighting inside Power Cogs will turn the fight in Clockwerk's favor.
Heavenly Grace dispels the stun from Overclocking while providing him with durability.

entries.name: Crystal Maiden
lines: Arcane Aura solves Omniknight's mana problems, and Omniknight can keep her protected in return with Heavenly Grace and Guardian Angel during her Freezing Field. Her slows and root also pair well with Degen Aura and Purification.

entries.name: Keeper of the Light
lines: Chakra Magic solves Omniknight's mana problems.

entries.name: Pudge
lines: A successful Meat Hook is an easy set-up for a Purification.
Omniknight can also offset the self-damage of Rot with Heavenly Grace.

entries.name: Storm Spirit
lines: Ball Lightning let's Storm Spirit get close for an easy Purification.
Heroes who can jump into enemy formations gives Omniknight an opening to use Purification offensively: Anti-Mage, Queen of Pain_new, Phantom Assassin, Earth Spirit

entries.name: Tango
lines: Tango is necessary for giving yourself flexibility when healing from enemy harass. Since Purification is so inefficient at low levels, you need a way to regenerate health without sacrificing your mana pool.

entries.name: Healing Salve
lines: Healing Salve also restores health to Omniknight.

entries.name: Clarity
lines: Clarity potions greatly help you to maintain lane presence due to Omniknight's small mana pool and costly, spammable spells.

entries.name: Enchanted Mango
lines: Enchanted Mango is a situationally useful laning item to purchase on Omniknight, as his mana pool is limited before he can purchase items to allow him to cast his spells. The passive HP regen gives him a measure of health sustain, and consuming it can give him enough mana to cast any of his spells at least one more time in a fight or gank if he runs out of mana.

entries.name: Iron Branch
lines: Iron Branch fills out any remaining inventory slots. Purchasing two of them allows you to either build a Magic Wand, or complete the two Mekansm components more readily.

entries.name: Observer Ward
lines: Observer Wards are a general requirement on support heroes, as map vision is a basic key to victory.

entries.name: Boots of Speed
lines: Boots of Speed are important on Omniknight as he can use them to take advantage of Degen Aura to slow enemies down, whether while pursuing during a gank or body-blocking chasing enemies attempting to kill your carry. As all of Omniknight's spells are very position-dependent, increasing his movement speed should be a major priority.

entries.name: Magic Stick
lines: Magic Stick is very useful on Omniknight due to his small mana pool. Having the ability to give yourself 150 mana can easily be the difference between being able to cast your spells or not.

entries.name: Urn of Shadows
lines: Urn of Shadows is a powerful support item that enhances Omniknight's ability to heal teammates and inflict magic damage. The item grants more strength, increasing Omniknight's HP and base damage, and some mana regen to help him manage his mana pool more efficiently. The active allows Omniknight to utilize yet another heal, or deal more magic damage in fights on top of Purification.

entries.name: Soul Ring
lines: Soul Ring should be the first major item that Omniknight purchases, as its active ability is what allows him to cast Purification more than once every few minutes. By alleviating his mana dependencies, Omniknight can become much more active in teamfights and ganks.

entries.name: Magic Wand
lines: Magic Wand gives Omniknight more attributes for little gold and allows him to replenish 255 health and mana instantly, enough to cast any of his abilities.

entries.name: Arcane Boots
lines: Arcane Boots is necessary to increase the size of Omniknight's small mana pool, allowing more frequent use of his mana-costly abilities. Moreover, the active ability allows him to replenish his and his team's mana pools, an essential duty for a support hero.

entries.name: Drum of Endurance
lines: Drum of Endurance, besides giving all-around attributes, further speeds Omniknight and his allies' movement and attack speed. The active charges can be used in conjunction with Degen Aura to further create a disparity in movement and attack speed between the respective teams.

entries.name: Mekansm
lines: Mekansm provides Omniknight with another source of healing, one that affects allies around him. Its all-around attributes and bonus armor also help to increase Omniknight's tankiness, but make sure that your mana pool is large enough to support the use of Mekansm, as it is extremely costly in mana to use.

entries.name: Aghanim's Scepter
lines: Aghanim's Scepter upgrades Guardian Angel into a global ability, giving it much greater utility as Omniknight doesn't need to be with his teammates for them to benefit from it, as well as bestowing physical immunity to all allied buildings. It also grants him additional attributes, health and mana.

entries.name: Boots of Bearing
lines: Boots of Bearing further increase Omniknight's survivability.The aura allows for agressive chases and improves splitpushing power.

entries.name: Guardian Greaves
lines: Guardian Greaves are a strong item to purchase on Omniknight in the late game, as he often builds a Mekansm and Arcane Boots already. Combining the two items into one inventory slot frees up space for more items in the late game, eliminates Mekansm's mana cost and strengthens its aura even further. As well, the self-dispel can allow Omniknight to instantly remove debuffs from himself that may be preventing him from contributing effectively in teamfights.

entries.name: Aghanim's Shard
lines: Aghanim's Shard will allow Omniknight's attacks to passively fire a Hammer of Purity at the target every 6 seconds and to heal himself for 30% of the damage dealt by Hammer of Purity.

entries.name: Lotus Orb
lines: Lotus Orb allows Omniknight to greatly hinder enemy attempts to focus down him or a teammate. The item's bonuses give Omniknight more armor and mana regen, increasing his durability and letting him cast his spells more frequently. Using Echo Shell on himself or a teammate in a fight allows him to use his enemies' disables and magical nukes against themselves, slowing the pace of a battle down and giving him more time to use his defensive spells.

entries.name: Radiance
lines: Radiance will provide great damage and passive AoE damage-per-second for Omniknight, it's evasion and blind can come in handy whenever Guardian Angel is on cooldown.

entries.name: Harpoon
lines: Harpoon will give Omniknight a great amount of strength and a good amount of agility and intelligence, it will also give Omniknight extra attack speed, attack damage and will boost Omniknight's mana regeneration that will allow Omniknight to use his abilities more often, as well as to have his melee attacks attack twice in a quick succession. Active ability of the Harpoon will also allow Omniknight to close the distance between his target and will guarantee that Purification damages and enemy Omniknight uses Harpoon on.

entries.name: Orb of Venom
lines: Orb of Venom is a useful early-game item to buy, as its slow stacks with that of Degen Aura.

entries.name: Scythe of Vyse
lines: Scythe of Vyse gives Omniknight mana regeneration and a hard disable, greatly increasing his teamfight contribution and his ability to gank targets.

entries.name: Shiva's Guard
lines: Shiva's Guard provides Omniknight with a great amount of armor for durability and intelligence for increasing the size of his mana pool. Both the active and passive abilities stack with Degen Aura, allowing him to drastically impede enemies' attempts to attack and move around in teamfights.

entries.name: Vladmir's Offering
lines: Vladmir's Offering is a useful all-around utility aura item to purchase. The armor and mana regen aura benefit your team, and the lifesteal and attack damage bonus give them an extra edge.

entries.name: Refresher Orb
lines: Refresher Orb is a strong pickup as it can allow Omniknight to cast Guardian Angel twice, as well as use Purification and Heavenly Grace in quick succession. However, refreshing your cooldowns is very costly in mana, so it is highly recommended to increase the size of your mana pool first if you intend on building this.

entries.name: Force Staff
lines: Force Staff is a useful item on any support hero, and is no exception on Omniknight. Being able to re-position quickly can allow you to use your spells to greater effect, as you can get within range for casting Purification to deal 360 pure damage to enemies, or instantly apply Degen Aura to a fleeing enemy. As well, it can be cast on fleeing allies to save them from chasing enemies, further augmenting Omniknight's ability to save teammates who are in trouble. The extra intelligence is also useful for increasing the size of your mana pool.

entries.name: Glimmer Cape
lines: Glimmer Cape is a useful mid-game utility item that can give Omniknight more initiation, utility and protection capability, once he has mitigated his mana deficiency issues. Using the active on an ally can allow them to initiate or gank an enemy, as well as letting them get right next to an enemy to hit them with Purification. If a teammate is initiated on by the enemy, using the active on them can give them extra magic resistance and give them temporary invisibility. Finally, Heavenly Grace can be used as a last-ditch measure to remove debuffs from an invisible ally, such as Dust of Appearance.

entries.name: Aether Lens
lines: Aether Lens is a strong utility item that boosts Omniknight's casting capabilities, and can be assembled more quickly by using the Energy Booster from a disassembled Arcane Boots. It provides more mana regen that compensates for Omniknight's pitiful pool, and the increased cast range allows him to use Purification and Heavenly Grace on allies from farther away, greatly increasing the survivability of his teammates.

entries.name: Eul's Scepter of Divinity
lines: Eul's Scepter of Divinity is a good cheap support item that provides many uses. The extra intelligence and mana regeneration ensure that Omniknight almost always has the mana he needs to cast his spells, while the extra movement speed allows him to capitalize on Degen Aura more easily. The active ability can be used to hard-disable an enemy, something that Omniknight otherwise lacks, and then get within range to cast Purification to deal damage to them, or can be cast on yourself to dispel debuffs from yourself (such as silences which may be preventing you from casting your spells).

entries.name: Solar Crest
lines: Solar Crest gives mana regeneration, armor, and attributes, increasing Omniknight's survivability. The active can transfer the armor bonus to a teammate, as well as increasing their movement and attack speed, protecting them even more on top of Purification and Heavenly Grace, or used on an enemy to inflict them with reduced armor, movement and attack speed that stacks alongside Degen Aura to greatly reduce their ability to inflict physical damage.

entries.name: Pipe of Insight
lines: Pipe of Insight is useful for protecting Omniknight and his team against magical damage in a teamfight, thus ensuring that he can cast his spells to their utmost and apply Degen Aura to the enemy for longer. The active ability also synergizes with his ability to protect his teammates from harm.

entries.name: Holy Locket
lines: Holy Locket is a strong pick giving you a enhanced HP and Mana pool, some extra stats, increased HP regeneration and a active that restores up to 300 HP and mana wen fully charged. The real strength in this item relies in the 35% heal amplification it gives to all your skills, which also applies to Mekansm and Guardian Greaves; greatly increasing your survivabillity and supporting ability.

entries.name: Crimson Guard
lines: Crimson Guard is a good pickup for Omniknight giving more resistance against physical damage, as he is a melee hero who must get close to the enemy to apply Degen Aura's debuff to them. However, its main use is in the active, Guard, which gives damage block and armor to all nearby teammates, very useful if you need to give them survivability against physical damage while your ultimate is on cooldown or you want to save it for more important situations.

pros: Наличие защиты и от магии, и от физического урона.
playstyle.text: Omniknight — стойкий защитник, герой поддержки и, в редких случаях — основы (чаще всего на сложной линии). Его мощные заклинания способны спасать союзников в самых трудных ситуациях. Способность Purification применяется на союзные цели, излечивая их и нанося чистый урон противникам вокруг. Это мощное и моментальное лечение, имеющее силу в средней стадии игры. В лобовой схватке эта способность может обратить нападение всех противников на одного союзника Omniknight против них же. Заклинание Heavenly Grace накладывает на союзную цель щит, который развеивает отрицательные эффекты и дарует значительный бонус к сопротивлению этим эффектам. Способность позволяет спасать союзников от оглушений, замедлений и прочих эффектов вывода из строя. Пассивная способность снижает скорость передвижения и атаки всех врагов рядом с Omniknight, благодаря чему он эффективно сражается в первых рядах, не давая врагам уходить или атаковать в полную силу. Ульт — Guardian Angel — является одним из сильнейших защитных заклинаний в игре. При использовании Omniknight дарует всем союзникам полную защиту от физического урона, фактически делая их неуязвимыми. В командном бою эта способность может полностью перевернуть ситуацию на пользу союзникам рыцаря-защитника.
cons: Отсутствие контроля и направленных на врагов способностей.

lines: Omniknight должен находится на небольшом расстоянии позади команды для того, чтобы сперва лечить союзников способностью Purification, а впоследствии давать Repel.
Стоит выучить все способности героев, научиться видеть их анимации и различать, чтобы вовремя обезвредить.
Может развеивать руны.
Примененная вовремя, может решить исход боя, что делает ее очень важным аспектом этого героя.
С Aghanim's Scepter использование ультимативной способности может спасти союзника на другом конце карты, но стоит подумать, окупиться ли это.

bio:
Ревнитель Громобой с раннего детства служил ордену, посвятившему себя подвигам во имя Всезнания. Прожив так много лет, он, будучи праведно верящим в своё дело, не раз отправлявшимся в далёкие края рыцарем, никогда не ставил свою веру под вопрос — их дело было правым, а кто был не с ними — тот был против них. В самом начале его, и без того готового на подвиги, подстёгивали юношеский кураж и молодость. Однако шли долгие годы крестовых походов, и вот сходили в могилы на краю дорог те, на службу к которым он когда-то поступал; вот один за одним пали в бою с жуткими, злыми сущностями, не признающими Всезнание, его братья по оружию, вместе с которыми он в детстве оказался в ордене; вот погибали его же собственные оруженосцы во многочисленных засадах, под натиском ужасных погодных условий далёких стран, от всевозможных болезней... Так, шаг за шагом, Громобой потерял былую уверенность в своих клятвах — и во всем их крестовом походе.

После глубокой медитации он откололся от военных сил ордена и отправился обратно в Эмарак, город на утёсах, знаменитый своим пещерным храмом, где и находились жрецы Всезнания. Ревнитель нашёл их и бросил вызов. Никто прежде не смел высказывать подобной наглости, и Громобоя поначалу пытались сбросить с утёса для жертвоприношений, но сколько бы человек на него не набрасывались и какие бы заклинания на него не обрушали — его так и не удавалось сдвинуть с места. И пролился на стойкую фигуру воина небесный свет — тогда служители храма поняли, что Всезнание избрало его, чтобы открыться. Отойдя прочь от избранного, они пропустили старейшину, чтобы тот открыл Ревнителю дверь в их святая святых, где хранились не свитки древней мудрости, не легендарные реликвии, в которые надо было для начала самому поверить, а туда, где находился тот, кто испокон веков жил внутри скалы — более того, тот, кто сам создал эту скалу бесчисленное множество лет назад, чтобы защититься от опасностей внешнего мира. По легенде, именно так мир был создан Всезнанием.

Тогда рыцарь всё осознал. У него не было более никакой причины сомневаться в истинности веры. Быть может, Всезнание и не было никаким создателем мира, но оно было реально. Теперь поход паладина имел смысл. За его целительными способностями и воинской хр
trivia: Некоторые части биографии Omniknight - являются отсылкой на библейскую историю о Данииле в Львиной Яме. Даниил был брошен в львиный рев за то, что ослушался указа Дария, молясь не ему а Богу, однако был чудесным образом спасён. Omniknight так же должен был быть сброшен с утеса жертвоприношений, из-за того что бросил вызов жрецам, но Всезнание избрало его, тем самым спасая Ревнителя.

Реплика Omniknight "I have gazed into the omniscience, and it has gazed into me." является отсылкой на цитату немецкого философа Фридриха Ницше "If you gaze long into an abyss, the abyss will gaze back into you.".
Реплика при убийстве "You chose poorly." и при покупке предмета "I chose wisely." является отсылкой на фильм Индиана Джонс и последний крестовый поход.

Множество фраз Omniknight ссылаются на библию или на христианство в целом, например: исповедание грехов, демоны в качестве заклятых врагов, критика в сторону Dazzle за использование тёмных сил для лечения, отвращение к Necronomicon (из-за его демонических сил), использование слов "Всезнание" и "свет" при описании своего бога, анимация смерти героя (руки с телом образуют крест, это отсылка на распятие Христа), и т.д. Реплика "A narrow path." ссылается на Евангелие Матфея 7:14.
Иногда Ревнителя называют "Чаком Норрисом", это прозвище появилось из-за их сходства во внешности.
Изначально Omniknight держал молот одной рукой, но после отзывов сообщества, анимация была изменена.
Реплика "The Omniscience may spare them, but I will not." это отсылка на фразу генерала Паттона " May God have mercy upon my enemies, because I won’t."

notes.text: Перекрестие указателя должно выделять союзное существо.
↓↓ Двойное нажатие автоматически применяет способность на себя.
Лечение не зависит от наносимого способностью урона.
Вопреки визуальным эффектам, урон наносится мгновенно всем врагам в радиусе вокруг цели.
Purification сначала излечивает союзника, затем наносит урон противникам.
Полностью действует на союзных курьеров.

abilities.lore: Жрецы Всезнания искусно избавляют братьев по оружию от скверны.
abilities.description: Мгновенно исцеляет союзное существо и наносит урон врагам вокруг него.
abilities.name: Purification
abilities.shard: После задержки в 3 сек. способность срабатывает на цель ещё раз, но в 65% от обычной силы.

notes.text: Can only be cast on ally heroes.
↓↓ Double-tapping automatically targets self.
Treats illusions, clones, and creep-heroes as heroes.
Although fully affecting creep-heroes, Repel does not grant them the strength bonus, except for the Spirit Bear.
Cannot be cast on Couriers.
Since Repel grants Debuff Immunity, only dispel sources that pierce debuff immunity (e.g. Doom) can dispel Repel.
Grants strength and health regeneration bonus based on the amount of current ent_text debuffs (i.e. detrimental ability effects) on the affected target conditionally. This includes the following:

All visible debuffs on the HUD. Although the HUD can only display 12 debuffs at most, each successive debuff applied on the affected target updates the ability values immediately. There is no limit to the granted bonuses.
Debuffs that have incremental stacks are considered as one debuff (e.g. Quill Spray).
Hidden modifiers do not affect the granted bonuses.
Successive casts do not stack but refresh its duration and ability values.
Both leveling up and the strength and health regeneration bonus per debuff increasing talent immediately updates all currently active Repel buffs.
Strength bonus: 7/14/21/28 + CurrentDebuffs × 3/4/5/6 (6/7/8/9).
Health regeneration bonus: 8/12/16/20 + CurrentDebuffs × 3/4/5/6 (6/7/8/9).
Repel effectively grants the following additional bonuses from its strength bonus per debuff:
7/14/21/28 + 3/4/5/6 (6/7/8/9) bonus main attack damage to heroes.
Can regenerate up to 51.78/79.56/107.34/135.12 + 19.62/26.16/32.7/39.24 (39.24/45.78/52.32/58.86) per debuff health over its full duration.
With the duration increasing talent, it can regenerate up to 69.04/106.08/143.12/180.16 + 26.16/34.88/43.6/52.32 (52.32/61.04/69.76/78.48) per debuff health over its full duration.

abilities.lore: Защита Всеведущего обуевает любого, кого Ревнитель называет другом.
abilities.description: Даёт цели невосприимчивость к эффектам и +60% к сопротивлению магии, а также увеличивает её восстановление здоровья.
abilities.name: Repel

notes.text: Хотя Hammer of Purity выглядит как способность ближнего бой, но её дальность применения увеличивает при помощи бонусов к дальности применения и не увеличивает бонусами к дальности атаки.
Снаряд летит со скоростью 1200.
Hammer of Purity сначала применяет замедление, затем наносит урон, затем лечит владельца.
Не совершает мгновенную атаку. Снаряд наносит обычный урон от заклинаний.
Это значит, что он не будет провоцировать срабатывание модификаторов атаки и будет игнорировать уклонение.
Это значит, что на урон будет взаимодействовать с усилением урона заклинаний и вампиризмом заклинаний.
Урон основывает на основном уроне от атаки самого Omniknight. Другие бонусы к урону от атаки игнорируются.
Средний урон способности может быть выражен как (50/75/100/125 + 36 + ΣСилы + 50) × 60%/80%/100%/120% (135%/155%/175%/195%)
Учитывает минимальные и максимальные значения урона заклинателя, поэтому урон варьируется так же, как и обычные атаки.
Урон зависит от базового урона Omniknight на момент попадания снаряда, а не его запуска.
Теперь автоматически применяет Hammer of Purity текущего уровня на цель атаки Omniknight. Пассивное применение обладает перезарядкой в 6 сек.
Пассивное применение ни уводит способность на перезарядку, ни тратит ману и срабатывает, пока способность находится на перезарядке. Однако оно не провоцирует эффекты, срабатывающие от применения.
Не прерывает приказы Omniknight.
Готовность пассивного применения отображается в виде иконки эффекта в интерфейсе. В противном случае иконка не отображается.

Omniknight получает модификатор при изучении Hammer of Purity, но он ничего не делает до получения Ability Upgrade. Поэтому при получении улучшения следующая атака всегда применяет Hammer of Purity при атаке.
Omniknight сначала наносит урон от атаки, затем применяет Hammer of Purity.
Эффект от пассивного применения Hammer of Purity блокируется блокировкой заклинаний.

abilities.lore: В сущности, рыцарь — это лишь удобный инструмент для перемещения молота.
abilities.description:
Герой наполняет свой молот священной силой, чтобы нанести чистый урон, зависящий от базового. Эта атака имеет увеличенную дальность и ненадолго замедляет цель.

На протяжении 4 сек. после атаки герой излечивается на 40% от нанесённого урона.
abilities.name: Hammer of Purity

notes: Не проходит сквозь невосприимчивость к эффектам.
abilities.lore: Одного священного вида Громобоя достаточно, чтобы неверующие ослабли.
abilities.description: Ослабляет врагов, осмелившихся подойти слишком близко, отчего скорость их передвижения снижается.
abilities.name: Degen Aura

notes.text: Guardian Angel делает так, что весь входящий по существам под действием этой способности физический урон, включая урон от атак, урон от заклинаний и урон от мгновенных атак, не засчитывается в журнале сражения.
Она не уменьшает входящий физический урон и не даёт физическое сопротивление.
Действует на всех союзных существ, за исключением вардов, курьеров, неуязвимых и спрятанных существ.
Теперь действует на постройки и спрятанных существ.
Сочетается мультпликативно с другими источниками сопротивления эффектам.
Приобретение Aghanim's Scepter мгновенно начинает давать сопротивление эффектам всем союзникам, на которых способность действовала до его получения.

abilities.lore: Защита Всеведущего обуевает любого, кого Ревнитель называет другом.
abilities.scepter: Делает радиус способности неограниченным. Она действует на постройки и увеличивает пополнение здоровья.
abilities.description: Призывает ангела-хранителя, который полностью защищает союзников поблизости от физического урона.
abilities.name: Guardian Angel

hype: Omniknight всегда готов помочь своей команде на передовой. Он излечивает союзников заклинанием, наносящим урон всем врагам вокруг, а в случае чего берётся за свой могучий молот и оберегает соратников от вреда.
name: Omniknight
short: Твёрдо стоит на передовой, защищая и излечивая союзников

talents.left: +75% к доле от базового урона у Hammer of Purity
